summary: 2D screening label: illustrative_2d_only (steady 2D is relevant, but only as a schematic). Studio did NOT run: simulation status is skipped because the input gate failed (a custom experiment needs 1-128 blocks and a power_w object; floorplan and power_w are empty). The input gate and scientific gate both failed, simulation_allowed is false, and comparison_valid is false. The scenario is Fig. 6 (p. 16) of the survey, a HotSpot modeling-flow schematic with seven power labels (0.2, 0.2, 1, 3, 2, 2, 1 W) and seven temperature labels (46, 46.1, 51, 62, 57, 55, 49 C). It names no blocks, gives no coordinates or dimensions, and does not map powers to blocks. The experiment kind is custom_2d_steady, so there is no transient trace. It is not a bundled EV6/GCC adaptation, and no pinned Ascend910/ATPlace assets, source commit, or generated-placement input.flp/input.ptrace exist. The packet has no assets and the paper links no repositories (checked_no_links). The 62 C label is a figure-label maximum with unspecified location, so it cannot be compared numerically to any Studio output. No result exists, and nothing here supports a claim of replication or exact agreement. Only qualitative remarks are defensible: HotSpot-style steady RC models give higher temperatures where per-block power is higher (3 W pairs with the 62 C maximum label, though that pairing is itself unmapped), and temperature depends on package and cooling assumptions that the paper does not specify for this example. The final verdict is no simulation and no valid comparison.
